description: Check whether REWORK actually ISSUED a credential - not just whether its signature verifies. A forged-but-well-formed token fails this; a real one returns its issuance record and the CURRENT OpenTimestamps receipt, which may have been upgraded to a Bitcoin confirmation since issue. Pass the credential (its sha256 is the lookup key) or the digest directly.

credential.description: The VC-JWT. Hashed locally; never sent anywhere.

digest.description: sha256 hex of the credential, if you already have it.

name: lookup_rework_attestation
